meta.name: screen-reader-testing
meta.description: Test web applications with screen readers including VoiceOver, NVDA, and JAWS. Use when validating screen reader compatibility, debugging accessibility issues, or ensuring assistive technology support.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 测试网页对读屏软件的兼容性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在测试网站的无障碍支持，需要验证读屏兼容性。
copy.tagline_en: Test web compatibility with screen readers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure your web app works with screen readers.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按这份指南陪你测网页在 VoiceOver、NVDA、JAWS 等屏幕阅读器下的表现:检查标题层级、地标、表单标签、动态内容播报与焦点管理,并给出对应的 ARIA 修复代码。
howto.when: 当你需要验证屏幕阅读器兼容性、调试辅助技术问题,或测试 ARIA 实现与动态内容播报时触发。

say.text: 用 NVDA 检查这个页面的标题和地标结构
say.note: 会按 NVDA 测试脚本逐项排查

say.text: 这个模态框的焦点管理在 VoiceOver 下有问题吗?
say.note: 会检查焦点陷阱与关闭后焦点返回

say.text: 帮我给这个表单加上能被读屏播报的错误提示

howto.what_en: Claude follows this guide to test your web pages with screen readers such as VoiceOver, NVDA and JAWS: checking headings, landmarks, form labels, live announcements and focus, and suggesting ARIA fixes.
howto.when_en: Use when validating screen reader compatibility, debugging assistive technology issues, or testing ARIA implementations and dynamic content announcements.

say_en.text: Check this page's heading and landmark structure with NVDA
say_en.note: Runs the NVDA test script step by step

say_en.text: Is this modal's focus handling broken in VoiceOver?
say_en.note: Reviews focus trap and focus return

say_en.text: Add error messages to this form that screen readers announce
